feed.title: AI Benefits Database: feed of new and revised cases

entry.title: Sky Sentinel AI turret may have downed four Shahed drones
entry.summary: Ukraine's Sky Sentinel, an AI-controlled heavy-machine-gun turret, is reported to have downed four Russian Shahed drones with one prototype; dates and places are withheld (May-June 2025).

entry.title: Kota police act on a Meta self-harm flag within a week of tie-up
entry.summary: Kota City SP Amrita Duhan said Meta's red-flag tags for suicidal posts go to a round-the-clock police team; within a week, police prevented a possible suicide by a student from Jhunjhunu (PTI).

entry.title: Instagram self-harm alert brings Satna police to a 17-year-old
entry.summary: 3 November 2022, about 5 pm: Instagram emailed MP cyber police a self-harm alert; Bhopal and Indore teams traced a 17-year-old to Satna in about an hour; she was counseled and sent home.

entry.title: GFW analysts help Indonesia seize MV NIKA; no AI detection
entry.summary: MV NIKA seized by Indonesia 12 July 2019 after INTERPOL tracking with OceanMind and GFW; captain convicted, owner fined, vessel forfeited; no source on file documents an AI detection.

entry.title: UN INSARAG teams in Adıyaman may have used xView2 damage maps
entry.summary: MIT Technology Review (20 February 2023), quoting DIU: xView2 used by two UN INSARAG teams in Adıyaman and by AFAD, World Bank, IFRC and WFP; Microsoft reports 3,849 damaged buildings mapped for AFAD.

entry.title: Turkmenistan repairs at least eight leaks after 192 MARS alerts
entry.summary: Eurasianet (3 September 2026) and The Chemical Engineer (May, Sep 2026), relaying UNEP: 192 MARS alerts to Turkmenistan in a year, about 40 answered, at least eight significant leaks repaired.

entry.title: UNEP MARS alerts lead operators to divert gas from Iraqi flare
entry.summary: The Chemical Engineer (5 May 2026), relaying UNEP: the largest source mitigated in 2026 was an Iraqi flare, 1.7m tCO2e since 2023, apparently in the Zubair field; Eni did not confirm closure.

entry.title: UNEP MARS alert leads to Alberta methane leak repair in a week
entry.summary: Trade press relaying UNEP's August 2026 snapshot: a 175 t/week methane plume at Alberta's Aerial field in April 2026 was traced to a failed ball valve on pigging equipment and repaired within a week.

entry.title: UNEP MARS alert stops Kazakhstan leak; emissions seen again
entry.summary: UNEP IMEO case KAZ_S_136: pipeline leak first detected Sept 2025, operator rerouted gas, mitigation reported 26 Nov 2025, last emissions 12 Mar 2026; subsequent emissions seen as of 21 May 2026.

entry.title: GraphCast may have forecast Lee's landfall nine days ahead
entry.summary: DeepMind says a live GraphCast run on ECMWF's site forecast Lee's Nova Scotia landfall about nine days ahead; NHC records landfall 16 September 2023; no forecaster use of the run is documented.

entry.title: Nuru may have lifted cassava yield from 0.5 kg to 2–5 kg a plant
entry.summary: PlantVillage's own 23 Mar 2020 post: after 18 months using Nuru, introduced via Self Help Africa and Ugunja Resource Center, Arisat reports 2.0–5.0 kg per plant against 0.5 kg; no independent source.

entry.title: Te Hiku Media's te reo Māori recognition may be 92% accurate
entry.summary: Iwi broadcaster's ASR, trained on 310 hours of community recordings (86% accuracy, 2022), reported at 92% in 2024; archive tests announced in 2024 with results to come; no speaker outcome documented.

entry.title: HALO's AI may spot mines in Ukraine with about 70% accuracy
entry.summary: HALO announced a US$4m AWS package (25 June 2024) to trial AI on drone imagery of Ukrainian minefields; Reuters (30 April 2026) reports about 70% accuracy; no cleared land or found mine attributed.

entry.title: CMD-1 cuts crisis triage from 9 hours to 8–13 minutes
entry.summary: Two-stage NLP (keyword filter plus logistic regression) screened 102,471 chat messages in October 2022 (AUC 0.98, sensitivity 0.98); daily median receipt-to-triage time 8–13 min versus 9 h before.

entry.title: Azure AI Vision app helps blind, low-vision adults in 354 tasks
entry.summary: Gonzalez Penuela et al. (CHI 2024) log 354 diary entries from 16 BLV participants using an Azure AI Vision app; uses include telling sunglasses from reading glasses without calling a spouse.

entry.title: Galaxy Watch4 Classic ECG flags AFib for Joseph Holycross, 39
entry.summary: A father of four ran the Galaxy Watch4 Classic ECG at his wife's urging; the AFib result sent him to the ER, where doctors confirmed AFib; open-heart surgery followed ten days later (Fox News, 2026).

entry.title: Microsoft's MatterGen generates TaCr2O6, measured at 169 GPa
entry.summary: Microsoft's diffusion model generated a structure conditioned on bulk modulus 200 GPa; SIAT (Shenzhen) synthesized it and measured 169 GPa, with Ta/Cr compositional disorder. Vendor co-authored proof.

entry.title: Johns Hopkins LSTM BCI lets a man with ALS spell for 90 days
entry.summary: A chronically implanted high-density ECoG BCI with an LSTM click detector trained on under 44 minutes of data supported switch-scan spelling for 626 minutes over 90 days, all in the laboratory.

entry.title: GNoME's 2.2 million predicted crystals may include useful compounds
entry.summary: Google DeepMind's GNoME proposed 2.2 million crystal structures (380,000 stable); independent reviews (Cheetham & Seshadri 2024, Kurlin 2026) find duplicates and scant evidence of useful compounds.

entry.title: Pindrop traces the Biden New Hampshire robocall to ElevenLabs
entry.summary: After a deepfake Biden robocall targeted New Hampshire's Jan 2024 primary, Pindrop's analysis against 120+ voice engines pointed to ElevenLabs; Hany Farid's Berkeley team reached the same conclusion.

entry.title: Big Sleep may have isolated SQLite zero-day CVE-2025–6965
entry.summary: Google says Big Sleep, fed indicators that attackers were staging a zero-day, isolated SQLite CVE-2025–6965; SQLite shipped the fix in 3.50.2 on 28 June 2025, announced 15 July 2025.

entry.title: Karolinska eye-tracking SVM flags reading risk at 95.6% accuracy
entry.summary: Nilsson Benfatto et al. trained an SVM on under-one-minute eye-tracking records from 97 high-risk and 88 low-risk Swedish children; 95.6% accuracy; two authors own equity in Optolexia.

entry.title: Rising Academies' WhatsApp tutor Rori lifts math scores 0.36 SD
entry.summary: Preprint by Oxford, Rising Academies and J-PAL North America authors: students using Rori one hour a week in study hall gained 0.36 SD more in math (637 baseline, 477 endline) than controls in 2023.

entry.title: Stanford's Tutor CoPilot lifts math mastery 4 percentage points
entry.summary: RCT with 900 tutors and 1,800 grade 3–8 students in a southern US district: students whose tutors had Tutor CoPilot were 4 points more likely to master topics; 9 points for lower-rated tutors.

entry.title: Mindspark raises Delhi students' math scores by 0.37 SD
entry.summary: Lottery evaluation of Educational Initiatives' Mindspark software plus small-group instruction among 619 Delhi public-school students: +0.37 SD math, +0.23 SD Hindi in 4.5 months.

entry.title: IMIE intelligent retina restores partial vision to a blind woman
entry.summary: Blind over a decade, a 61-year-old woman read E optotypes and walked indoors unaided after a 256-channel IMIE retinal implant in Changsha.

entry.title: BrainGate2 neuroprosthesis lets a paralyzed man type 22 wpm
entry.summary: Two BrainGate2 participants typed by attempted finger movement at up to 22 wpm, 1.6% word error, in at-home research sessions (Mar 2026).

entry.title: FAO and Penn State launch Nuru to confirm fall armyworm damage
entry.summary: FAO announced on 25 June 2018 a talking Android app built with PlantVillage to confirm fall armyworm damage offline and feed FAO's FAMEWS; no outcome data in the sources.

entry.title: Google FINDER flags restaurants 3.1 times as likely to be unsafe
entry.summary: Health departments inspected 132 FINDER-flagged restaurants in 2016–2017; 52.3% were unsafe versus 24.7% of 10,786 other inspections (odds ratio 3.06).

entry.title: India's DoT disconnects over 82 lakh connections flagged by ASTR
entry.summary: DoT's indigenous ASTR tool matches subscriber photos to find connections taken by one person under different names; a Rajya Sabha reply (August 2025) counts more than 82 lakh disconnected after fai...

entry.title: VeriPol flags 25 and 39 false robberies in Murcia and Málaga
entry.summary: The Spanish National Police's text-based false-report classifier flagged 25 false robberies in Murcia and 39 in Málaga in a week in June 2017 (versus 3 and 12 in the same month over the prior decad...

entry.title: ActiveRemediation guides Flint digs to a 70% lead-pipe hit rate
entry.summary: A University of Michigan XGBoost and active-learning model guided Flint's FAST Start digs; 6,228 of 8,833 homes inspected through 2017 had lead pipes replaced (70%), versus 15% in 2018 without it.

entry.title: Meta flags a suicide post; Raebareli police arrive in 12 minutes
entry.summary: 29 March 2026: Meta alert at 8:58 pm; Raebareli police reached an 18-year-old in 12 minutes after rat poison; hospital treatment, stable

entry.title: STAR finds two motile sperm; couple conceives after 19 years
entry.summary: STAR AI found 7 sperm (2 motile) in 2.5m images of a “sperm-free” sample; a couple infertile for 19 years conceived and had a girl.

entry.title: KTÜ students' app pings phones about 30 seconds before a quake
entry.summary: KTÜ students' AI quake app alerted phones about 30 s before a Kulu quake (DHA 5.2, USGS 5.0) was felt at Turkey's parliament, 15 May 2025.

entry.title: Google alerts Crete phones seconds before the M6.0 Kasos quake
entry.summary: Android users in Crete and the Dodecanese got Google's quake alert seconds before the M6.0 (Greek press 6.1) Kasos quake of 14 May 2025.

entry.title: Turkish Brain Project algorithm flags a glioma mid-scan at Gazi
entry.summary: Real-time MRI algorithm at Gazi University Hospital alerted doctors to a 46-year-old woman's glioma mid-scan; biopsy next day, Oct 2022.

entry.title: CMUH's exercise-ECG AI catches a 99% LAD stenosis rated moderate
entry.summary: CMUH's exercise-ECG AI put severe-blockage odds at 72% where manual reading said follow-up; angiography found a 99% LAD stenosis, stented.

entry.title: Meta alert brings police and psychologists to a Paraguayan teen
entry.summary: Meta flagged a Paraguayan teen's post praising the Uvalde shooter; the FBI relayed it and police, prosecutors and psychologists intervened.

entry.title: Google alerts Alanya phones seconds before a M5.1 quake
entry.summary: Android users near Alanya, Turkey, got Google's earthquake alert seconds before a M5.1 (AFAD 5.3) offshore quake on 5 January 2022.

entry.title: Google Research RMAB cuts mMitra engagement drops by 32%
entry.summary: RMAB picked weekly service calls among 23,003 mMitra mothers from 26 April 2021; 32% fewer engagement drops than standard care

entry.title: Google Flood Hub triggers pay $105 to 4,600 people in Kogi
entry.summary: Google Flood Hub forecast triggers paid $105 to 4,600 people in Ibaji, Kogi State, mostly before floods peaked on 21 October 2024

entry.title: Novissi targeting pays 138,531 rural beneficiaries in Togo
entry.summary: ML on satellite imagery and phone metadata set eligibility for Novissi rural cash; 138,531 beneficiaries paid, Nov 2020 to Aug 2021

entry.title: Google Flood Hub skillful enough for seven-day Mali early action
entry.summary: Independent study finds Google Flood Hub skillful beyond 4-day lead time, enough for 7-day Mali Red Cross early action triggers.

entry.title: UNEP MARS alert leads to methane leak repair at Hassi Messaoud
entry.summary: MARS alert led an Algerian operator to fix an unlit flare at Hassi Messaoud; satellites show no emissions since 15 October 2024.

entry.title: GraphCast matches best operational cyclone track models in 2023
entry.summary: CIRA/Colorado State evaluation: GraphCast and three AI models match top operational cyclone track models in 2023; adding all four cut consensus error 11% at 120 h.

entry.title: DeepMind's GDMI beats NHC Atlantic track forecasts at 12–72 h
entry.summary: NHC's 2025 verification: Google DeepMind ensemble mean beat official Atlantic track forecasts at 12–72 h; first AI models in NHC operations.

entry.title: NHC blends DeepMind's ensemble into Hurricane Melissa forecasts
entry.summary: NHC blended Google DeepMind's AI ensemble into official Melissa forecasts from its first advisory on 21 October 2025; Cat 5 landfall in Jamaica 28 October 2025.

entry.title: AlphaEvolve finds 48-multiplication 4x4 complex matrix algorithm
entry.summary: AlphaEvolve found a 48-multiplication 4x4 complex matrix algorithm (May 2025); Dumas, Pernet and Sedoglavic derived rational variants from its decomposition

entry.title: Google Arts & Culture Lab recolours Klimt's destroyed paintings
entry.summary: ML color reconstruction of Klimt's destroyed Faculty Paintings launched 7 October 2021 with the Belvedere, shown in its 2025 exhibition

entry.title: AlphaProof and AlphaGeometry 2 reach IMO silver-medal standard
entry.summary: DeepMind AI scored 28/42 on IMO 2024 problems, graded by Gowers and Myers; Gemini Deep Think's 35/42 in 2025 was IMO-certified gold

entry.title: Confirmed TREWS sepsis alerts are linked to 3.3% lower mortality
entry.summary: Prospective five-hospital study: sepsis alerts confirmed within 3 h had 3.3% absolute lower in-hospital mortality (CI 1.7–5.1).

entry.title: CapisciAMe CNN outperforms familiar listeners on impaired speech
entry.summary: A CNN trained only on one patient's voice recognized 72.65% of her words versus 56.75% for 12 familiar professionals; lab result only.

entry.title: BrainGate wireless iBCI lets T5 and T10 use a tablet at home
entry.summary: Two men with tetraplegia used a wireless BrainGate iBCI at home for web browsing, apps and typing, with 24-hour home recording.

entry.title: PAWS-directed patrols remove over 1,000 snares in Cambodia
entry.summary: PAWS-directed ranger patrols in Srepok Wildlife Sanctuary removed over 1,000 snares in December 2018, versus 200–300 in a typical month.

entry.title: Galaxy Fit pulse of 188 bpm leads to WPW diagnosis and ablation
entry.summary: Galaxy Fit recorded a resting pulse of 188 bpm; a routine ECG next day showed WPW and the band's records supported referral for successful ablation (South Korea, 2020).

entry.title: IBM–Yamagata AI survey confirms 303 new Nazca geoglyphs in Peru
entry.summary: An IBM–Yamagata deep-learning survey guided fieldwork that confirmed 303 new Nazca geoglyphs, published in PNAS (Sep 2024).

entry.title: DeepMind's FunSearch finds a size-512 cap set in dimension 8
entry.summary: FunSearch produced a size-512 cap set in dimension 8 and new asymptotic bounds, published in Nature with independent commentary.

entry.title: Meta self-harm alert gets Meerut police to a man in 8 minutes
entry.summary: 7 June 2026: Meta alert at 6:53 pm; Meerut police reached a 25-year-old in 8 minutes, found him critical; hospital treatment, improved

entry.title: Police phone app identifies man wanted since 2012 in Cardiff
entry.summary: A South Wales Police officer's OIFR phone app matched a 38-year-old in Cardiff to a 2012 Polish European arrest warrant for drug dealing and assaulting an officer; he was remanded (July 2025).
